scenes.title: Microsoft: map needs to the right layer
scenes.body: Bottom line: Microsoft is a portfolio, not one system; first map the need to Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure or Copilot, then verify entitlements early.
scenes.narration: Bottom line: Microsoft is a portfolio, not one system; first map the need to Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure or Copilot, then verify entitlements early.
claims: Windows 11 is the client operating-system layer for PC experience and user productivity.
Microsoft 365 combines Office apps with online services for email, file storage, collaboration and meetings.
Azure is the cloud-services layer for building and managing applications, including AI, compute and storage categories.
Copilot Chat provides AI assistance to eligible Microsoft 365 users for information, content and tasks.
Copilot capability and grounding depend on access point, service capacity and Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing.
The selected sources describe separate product layers: Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure and Copilot Chat.
